title: Editor Canvas Text Descendant Selection
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository set, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
Canvas preview text descendant clicks cannot select the exact editable text-block descendant represented inside a columns or table surface.
Structure or Outline highlight still shows only the owning columns or table surface after clicking a represented child text block in the paper preview.
Ordinary canvas selection, drag, reorder, keyboard, inspector, delete, duplicate, or structural commands stop resolving internal nodes through their owning operation surface.
The new canvas text descendant selection source leaks into Backend mutation request sources or add-node mutation source contracts.
The live Backend browser smoke cannot prove preview text descendant selection and persisted selectedOutlineNodeIds after reload.

The slice enables WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct click-to-type authoring, exact cell/column layout authoring, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, field-ref editing, durable drafts, collaboration, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, or map truth.
verificationTarget: Editor adds a selection-only canvas preview text-descendant hit target so clicking text represented inside columns/table preview surfaces selects the exact editable text-block descendant and visibly highlights the matching Structure/Outline item, while ordinary canvas and structural mutation behavior remain surface-based and Backend mutation sources remain guarded.
summary: Done: Editor commit 940b4dfc5f61fa551993c9c853c5c8aed0a986c5 adds bounded canvas text descendant selection. Paper preview text cells represented inside columns/table surfaces now expose a selection-only data-canvas-text-descendant-id marker. PaperPageStack checks that marker before ordinary canvas hit testing and routes selection through the canvas-text-descendant source, so Structure/Outline can highlight exact editable text-block descendants such as summary-left-text after clicking the represented preview text. Ordinary canvas selection, drag/reorder, and structural mutation paths remain surface-based, and Backend mutation request building rejects canvas-text-descendant as a mutation source. The live local Backend browser smoke now selects summary-left-text through the paper preview, records selectedOutlineNodeIds and reloadedSelectedOutlineNodeIds as summary-left-text, and still keeps WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct click-to-type authoring, exact table/column layout authoring, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, field-ref editing, durable drafts, broad frontend readiness, and map truth closed.
